globalBoundary: Camera metrics describe 2D/3D image-plane swing motion. They do not measure ground reaction forces (GRF), 3D moments (GRM at COP), muscular torque, or fascial loading.

golfSwitchFailureModes.name: Backswing Trail-Hip Loading Switch (SPL/LL Trail Anchor)
golfSwitchFailureModes.mechanism: Trail Gluteus Medius (Local LL) fails to anchor; TFL/ITB (Express LL) slides hip away from target, causing Trail Sway.

golfSwitchFailureModes.name: Transition Pelvis-Thorax X-Factor Dissociation Switch (BFL/FFL Stretch-Shortening)
golfSwitchFailureModes.mechanism: Upper body Pectoralis/Latissimus (Express FFL/BFL) fire before pelvic transition, causing Over-the-Top steep downswing.

golfSwitchFailureModes.name: Impact Lead-Leg Post & Ground Transfer Switch (DFL/LL Lead Post)
golfSwitchFailureModes.mechanism: Lead Psoas/Adductors (DFL) fail to centrate hip; pelvis thrusts forward toward ball (Early Extension).

golfSwitchFailureModes.name: Follow-Through Deceleration Switch (SBL/SPL Deceleration Sling)
golfSwitchFailureModes.mechanism: Posterior Thoracic Erectors & Rhomboids fail to decelerate high-speed rotation smoothly post-impact.

entries.title: Trail hip sway observation
entries.observationTemplate: Trail hip midpoint moved {value} normalized units away from target during backswing.
entries.strategyInterpretation: Describes a lateral shift strategy of the trail hip during backswing coiling.
entries.switchFailureMode: Backswing Trail-Hip Loading Switch Failure — Trail Gluteus Medius fails to anchor, allowing lateral sway.

entries.title: Pelvis-thorax separation timing
entries.observationTemplate: Pelvis leads thorax by {value} milliseconds at downswing initiation.
entries.strategyInterpretation: Describes downswing kinematic sequencing and pelvis-first transition.
entries.switchFailureMode: Transition X-Factor Switch Failure — Upper body fires before pelvic transition.
